morphology.pattern_note: -an 构成名词，可表示所抱之物、被抱状态、承托位置或抽象支持；ng 表示单一辅音 /ŋ/。IPA 采用词包候选读音，另列有 [do.ko.ŋan]。

senses.zh_definition: 抱着或背着的人或物，即被承托的对象。
senses.en_definition: A person or thing being carried against the body.
senses.nuances: 指被抱的对象，而非抱人的动作或工具；现代常见于叙事文字。此义较少见，所列为典型用法，不声称具有高语料频率。[DBP 四义依据](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=dukungan)。

collocations.en: to put down what one is carrying

collocations.zh: 将所抱的人或物放下来
collocations.en: to lower the person or thing being carried

senses.zh_definition: 被人抱着或背着的状态。
senses.en_definition: The state of being carried in someone's arms or against their body.
senses.nuances: 典型结构为 dalam dukungan，常用于婴幼儿；强调被抱着的状态。

senses.zh_definition: 身体上用来抱、背或承托人或物的部位，如腰侧、背部或手臂。
senses.en_definition: The bodily position or support on which someone or something is carried.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat mendukung pada tubuh, seperti pinggang, belakang atau tangan.
senses.nuances: 与“被抱状态”密切相关，但侧重承托的位置；不泛指椅子、货架等支架。此义偏叙事性，所列为典型表达。

collocations.zh: 在他或她承托的部位上
collocations.en: resting where he or she is carrying them

collocations.zh: 在母亲抱着的位置上睡着
collocations.en: to fall asleep resting against the mother's supporting body

senses.zh_definition: 为某人、团体、主张或事业提供的支持、援助或协助。
senses.en_definition: Support, backing, or assistance given to a person, group, cause, or undertaking.
senses.nuances: Kamus Dewan 收录此义，并非仅限印度尼西亚语。马来西亚日常表达也常用 sokongan；dukungan 较适合正式、组织或理念层面的支持。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pelaksanaan program ini memerlukan dukungan semua pihak, termasuk persatuan penduduk dan pihak berkuasa tempatan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 落实这项计划需要各方支持，包括居民协会和地方政府。
dual_scenarios.en: Implementing this programme requires support from all parties, including residents' associations and local authorities.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Adik dah lena dalam dukungan ayah, jangan bising sangat ya.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adik sudah tidur lena dalam dukungan ayah. Jangan terlalu bising.
dual_scenarios.zh: 小的已经在爸爸怀里睡熟了，别太吵哦。
dual_scenarios.en: The little one's fast asleep in Dad's arms. Keep it down, okay?
spoken_features: Adik 可作为家中较小孩子的称呼
dalam dukungan 在口语中带有较温柔的叙述色彩

messages.speaker: Aina (家人)
messages.ms_spoken: Adik dah tidur ke? Tadi aku nampak dia dalam dukungan ayah.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah adik sudah tidur? Tadi saya melihatnya dalam dukungan ayah.
messages.zh: 小的睡了吗？刚才我看见爸爸还抱着他。
messages.en: Has the little one fallen asleep? I saw Dad carrying him earlier.

messages.speaker: Hakim (家人)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, lena betul. Ayah nak letak dia atas katil kejap lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tidur dengan lena. Ayah hendak membaringkannya di atas katil sebentar lagi.
messages.zh: 睡了，睡得可香了。爸爸一会儿就把他放到床上。
messages.en: Yes, he's out like a light. Dad's going to put him to bed in a moment.

etymology.historical_story: Dukungan is formed from dukung, meaning to carry against the body, and the noun-forming suffix -an. Kamus Dewan illustrates its concrete meaning with Malim Deman putting down what he carries. Its figurative sense names social assistance: supporting a cause can be understood through the familiar physical image of helping to bear a weight. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=dukungan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: dukung 是“抱住、托住”，加 -an 成为“所抱之物、怀抱状态、支持”：双手托住孩子，众人托住事业。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 公开感谢时可说 Terima kasih atas dukungan semua pihak，语气正式得体；日常对朋友说 Terima kasih atas sokongan awak 更自然。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于家庭叙述、文学、社团活动及正式声明。dukungan rakyat 表示民众支持，使用时应有事实依据；这个词本身不表示某种特定政治立场。
